data_source: RIPE Stat BGP updates + RIPE NCC RPKI archive snapshots
correlation_method: For announcements, use the latest daily RPKI snapshot at or before the BGP event timestamp and validate the last AS in its path.
limitations: Daily snapshots do not establish the exact RPKI state at every event time.
Snapshot filename dates are used as timestamps; their precise temporal semantics must be verified.
Withdrawals are not assigned an origin AS or validation state.
BGP events are observations from the queried data source, not a complete global view.
Temporal correlation does not establish RPKI causation.
